title: Sauron's mark in the frozen fortress
description: After centuries of hunting, Galadriel's company reaches an abandoned stronghold in the Forodwaith. Inside they find Sauron's sigil burned into an anvil and kill a snow-troll — but her soldiers refuse to follow her any further north.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

title: The Harfoots of Rhovanion
description: A hidden camp of Harfoots waits for its next migration. Nori Brandyfoot keeps wandering beyond the permitted trails, to the dismay of her elders.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

title: Galadriel is honoured, and sent away
description: In Lindon, Elrond urges Galadriel to put up her sword. High King Gil-galad declares the war over and rewards her company with passage across the sea to Valinor.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

title: Arondir's last watch
description: The Elves' long watch over the Southlands is ending. Arondir, drawn to the healer Bronwyn, lingers in Tirharad — where a cow giving black milk hints that something is wrong in the land.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

title: A broken sword under the floorboards
description: Bronwyn's son Theo shows a friend what he has found hidden in a barn: the hilt of a black sword marked with Sauron's sign, which stirs when it tastes his blood.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

title: Hordern in flames
description: Following the sickness to its source, Arondir and Bronwyn come over a hill to find the neighbouring village burning and empty.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

title: The ship leaves the Grey Havens
description: Galadriel boards the ship for the Undying Lands with the soldiers of her company.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

title: Galadriel leaps into the sea
description: At the very threshold of Valinor, Galadriel cannot let her hunt go. As the light opens for her companions she steps back and dives into the sea, an ocean away from Middle-earth.

title: A man falls from the sky
description: A meteor crosses the whole of Middle-earth and crashes near the Harfoot camp. In the burning crater Nori finds a huge, bewildered stranger.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com
